words.explanation: n. [C, U] a wide road with an area of grass and trees in the middle or along the sides 林阴大路
n. [C] the area or road for cars between a house and the street 私家车道
n. [C, U] a load of goods being delivered, or the act of sending them（运送的）一批货物；（货物的）运送
words.example: Her order will be ready for shipment tomorrow.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] the goods that are being carried in a ship or plane（一批）货物
words.example: The ship was carrying a cargo of oil.

words.explanation: v. to take air into your lungs and send it out again 呼吸
words.example: We are getting more and more concerned about the quality of the air we breathe.

words.explanation: a. sth. that is invisible cannot be seen 看不见的；隐形的
words.example: This is a secret message written in invisible ink.

words.explanation: a. impossible to avoid 不可避免的
words.example: Man has an inescapable responsibility for his own actions.

words.explanation: a. sb. or sth. that is indispensable is so important or useful that it is impossible to manage without them 必需的；不可或缺的
words.example: Police dogs are indispensable in the war on drugs.

words.explanation: vi. to come out of your mouth, although you did not intend it to（不自觉地）发出，说出
words.example: A slight sigh escaped from her lips.

words.explanation: vt. to discuss, examine, or think about sth. carefully 检查；研究；探讨
words.example: The film explores issues about the aging society.

words.explanation: n. [C] a situation or statementthat seems impossible or is difficult to understand because it contains two opposite facts or characteristics 自相矛盾的情况；似非而是的说法；悖论
words.example: It's a paradox that in such a rich country there can be so much poverty.

words.explanation: n. [C]（冲洗胶卷的）暗室，暗房，黑房
n. [C] a very frightening dream 噩梦；梦魇
words.example: I had a nightmare yesterday about being drowned in a lake.

words.explanation: vi. to think about sth. nice, e.g. sth. you would like to happen, esp. when this makes you forget what you should be doing 做白日梦；幻想；梦想
words.example: Stop daydreaming and get back to work!

words.explanation: n. [C] 野丫头；假小子
n. [C] 助产士；接生员；产婆
n. [C, U] wet sand that is dangerous because it pulls you down into it if you walk on it 流沙
n. [C, U] 塑料；塑胶
n. [C] 桌布；台布
n. [C] 1 ( AmE bathtub ) 浴缸；澡盆
words.example: Please wash yourself quickly because I need to clean the bath tonight.

words.explanation: n. [C] ( old use ) a hospital for people who are mentally ill 精神病院
ad. by means of language 言辞上
a. seriously mentally ill and unable to live in normal society 精神错乱的；精神失常的
a. very little 微小的
words.example: She has only a slim chance of passing the exam.

words.explanation: a. severe, angry, and criticizing 尖锐的；严厉的；气愤的；责备的
words.example: Despite his sharp tongue, he gets loyalty from his friends.

words.explanation: a. speaking in an honest way even if this upsets people（说话）不客气的；直言不讳的；耿直的
words.example: His request was met with a blunt refusal.

words.explanation: vt. to not notice sth. 未注意到；忽视
words.example: You should not overlook the difficulties.

words.explanation: vt. to be in charge of a program of work or a group of workers, and check that everything is done correctly 监管；监察；监督
words.example: You must hire someone to oversee the project.

words.explanation: a. sth. that is visible can be seen 看得见的；可见的
words.example: The hills were hardly visible through the mist.

words.explanation: n. [C] a short piece of writing about a particular subject, esp. as part of a class at school or college 短文；论说文；散文
words.example: We need to hand in an essay about Chinese culture.

words.explanation: v. ( ~ at ) to feel great surprise or admiration for the quality of sth. 对…感到惊讶；叹赏；钦佩
words.example: People marveled at how well these animals have adapted themselves to the polar ice caps.

words.explanation: n. [U] a situation or behavior that is completely crazy 疯狂的状态（行为）
words.example: It must be lunacy to turn down a great oﬀer like that.

words.explanation: n. [C] 1 a language 语言
n. [C] ( or ~ clock ) 闹钟
n. [C] a line of numbers or words written under each other that goes down a page（数字、单词的）列
vt. ( fml. ) to say publicly or officially that sth. important is true or exists 宣布；声明
words.example: The leader has proclaimed a great victory.

words.explanation: vt. if one statement, piece of evidence, story, etc. contradicts another, they disagree and cannot both be true 与…相矛盾；与…抵触；违背
words.example: Smith gave an account that contradicted the evidence that we collected.

words.explanation: a. producing or using new and effective ideas, results, etc. 创造（性）的
words.example: I enjoy my job because most of the time I can do creative things.

words.explanation: a. ( only before noun ) causing fear 吓人的；可怕的
words.example: There is a fearful storm in the south.

words.explanation: n. [U] the appearance that sth. has when its two sides or halves are different in shape, size, or style 不对称
1 not less than a particular amount or number, and possibly more（数量或数目上）至少，起码
words.example: The disease killed at least 100 people in England last year.

words.explanation: to expect that the things or advantages that you have will always exist, and so not pay much attention to them 视某事物为理所当然（因而对其不太关注）
words.example: You can never take it for granted that what you read, see or hear from media is true.

words.explanation: to stop for a moment in order to consider sth. 退一步考虑
words.example: Let's step back and have another look at this problem.

words.explanation: to happen 发生；举行
words.example: I don't know what took place in the classroom.

words.explanation: (in) the clear light of day, when it is easy to see 光天化日（之下）
words.example: A woman was attacked on a train in broad daylight.

words.word: quite a lot / a bit / a few
words.explanation: a large number or amount 许多；大量
words.phonetic: quite a lot  a bit  a few.mp3

words.explanation: 1 to turn sth. such as a handle or part of a machine around and around, esp. in order to make sth. move or start working 摇动，转动（把手等）；给（机器）上发条
words.example: He wound up his old watch and let it go.

words.explanation: to get rid of or destroy sth. by burning 焚毁；烧掉
words.example: The fire burned up 100 acres of farmland.

words.explanation: to be destroyed, or to destroy sth., by fire（被）焚毁
words.example: The house burned down in the big fire.

words.explanation: to become slower or make sth. slower（使）慢下来；（使）减速
words.example: Slow up / down, or you're going to hit that tree!

words.explanation: to write all the necessary information in special spaces on a document 填写
words.example: Fill out the form carefully, and keep copies of it.

words.explanation: to start making a noise as a signal or warning （警报等）响起来
words.example: I was just lying in bed waiting for the alarm to go oﬀ.

words.explanation: 1 to calculate the total of several numbers or amounts 把…加起来
words.example: When you add up the numbers in the column, you'll see how big our profit really is.

words.explanation: to say sth. that is the opposite of what you said before 自相矛盾
words.example: In his confusion, he kept contradicting himself.

words.explanation: 沃尔特・惠特曼（1819-1892，美国著名诗人）
